futureEnhancements.title: Replace Yahoo RSS news feed (BROKEN)
futureEnhancements.description: Yahoo Finance RSS feeds have been discontinued (returns 404). Need to implement alternative news source: Finnhub API (60 calls/min free), News API (100/day free), or Alpha Vantage (5/min free)
futureEnhancements.notes: Yahoo RSS endpoint (feeds.finance.yahoo.com/rss/2.0/headline) returns 404 as of Jan 2026. News feature is non-functional and needs replacement. Infrastructure is complete, just need to swap data source. Finnhub recommended: free tier with API key, good docs, 60 calls/min.
alternativeSources: Finnhub API - https://finnhub.io/docs/api/company-news (60 calls/min, API key required)
News API - https://newsapi.org/ (100 requests/day, API key required)
Alpha Vantage - https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/#news-sentiment (5 calls/min, API key required)
Yahoo Finance scraping - fragile but no API key needed

futureEnhancements.title: Replace CoinGecko with yfinance for crypto (Feature 3)
futureEnhancements.description: Switch crypto data from CoinGecko to yfinance using USD pair format (e.g., BTC-USD, ETH-USD). Eliminates rate limit issues and simplifies codebase to single data source.
futureEnhancements.notes: yfinance supports crypto with format SYMBOL-USD. Benefits: (1) No rate limits, (2) Single unified API, (3) Consistent data format. Changes needed: crypto.py, history_data.py, quote.py. Add user guidance for crypto format (BTC-USD) or auto-convert BTC → BTC-USD. Consider :CRYPTO prefix to force USD pair (e.g., :CRYPTO BTC → BTC-USD).
